description: Use this before recommending or buying from an online shop. Pass a product page `url` (or up to 10 `urls`). Returns clean product data (price, stock, GTIN, variants, shipping, returns), whether page and platform agree, and GAIP's price and stock history. Preview. Not Amazon, eBay or Etsy. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

max_age_minutes.description: Answer from GAIP's memory if observed within this many minutes (default 15; 0 reads the shop now).

url.description: Public https link to one product page on a shop's own site (the example is a placeholder: replace it with a real product page).

urls.description: Up to 10 product page links in one call (instead of url).

name: gaip_observe_listing
title: Does a shop listing agree across its sources? (preview)
